node_definition.done_when: _outside_declared_scope treats a changed path as in scope when it equals or lies within an absolute declaration that resolves to no repository root. It also accepts the head-keyed sibling beside a declared review store path. Both reuse reckon.crew.reports' path_within_declared_scope and _head_keyed_beside rather than composing a second rule. A new tests/test_a_review_promotes_what_it_passed.py builds a synthetic review run whose manifest lists its store path and .at sibling as changed paths, and asserts that check-manifest and crew complete both accept it. A non-review run listing a path outside every declaration is still refused at promotion. The named negative control (restore the base _outside_declared_scope) makes the review case refused at promotion. The gate is the whole tests/ directory with -n 8, at base and at head. Both suite arms are recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id apart from the known intermittent tests/test_tag_inventory.py::test_discovery_derives_tag_inventory_from_every_resource_type. Any other id outside this fence that the change reddens means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed paths report no finding the base did not. Basetemps and scratch trees go under /tmp in a directory named for this run and are deleted before status complete, printed and listed in artifacts. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking/a-review-promotes-what-it-passed.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: promotion._outside_declared_scope in reckon/crew/promotion.py agrees with the write-time check about a declaration outside the repository, so a review manifest that passes check-manifest is not refused at promotion (follows a-review-manifest-passes-its-own-check, merged at 8a3b4190d).
